sections.title: Complete Architecture Summary
sections.body:
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│               ALL 8 ARCHITECTURES — DECISION GUIDE                   │
├──────────────────┬──────────────┬────────────────┬────────────────── │
│  Architecture    │  Best For    │  Weakness      │  Use When          │
├──────────────────┼──────────────┼────────────────┼────────────────── │
│  1. Single Agent │  Simple,     │  Gets confused │  1-5 tool calls    │
│     (ReAct)      │  focused     │  on complex    │  One domain        │
│                  │  tasks       │  multi-domain  │                    │
├──────────────────┼──────────────┼────────────────┼────────────────── │
│  2. Supervisor   │  Complex     │  Single point  │  Multi-domain      │
│                  │  multi-part  │  of failure    │  Needs synthesis   │
│                  │  tasks       │  at supervisor │                    │
├──────────────────┼──────────────┼────────────────┼────────────────── │
│  3. Router       │  High        │  Can't handle  │  Clear query       │
│                  │  throughput  │  hybrid queries│  types, fast       │
│                  │  routing     │                │  response needed   │
├──────────────────┼──────────────┼────────────────┼────────────────── │
│  4. Pipeline     │  Sequential  │  Slow (no      │  Each step builds  │
│                  │  transformations│ parallelism) │  on previous      │
├──────────────────┼──────────────┼────────────────┼────────────────── │
│  5. Reflection   │  Quality     │  Expensive     │  Quality critical  │
│                  │  critical    │  (multiple     │  Code, writing,    │
│                  │  tasks       │  LLM calls)    │  analysis          │
├──────────────────┼──────────────┼────────────────┼────────────────── │
│  6. Parallel     │  Independent │  Harder to     │  Multiple          │
│                  │  subtasks    │  debug         │  independent       │
│                  │  Speed       │                │  workstreams       │
├──────────────────┼──────────────┼────────────────┼────────────────── │
│  7. Debate       │  Controversial│ Expensive,    │  High-stakes       │
│                  │  decisions   │  slow          │  decisions,        │
│                  │              │                │  complex trade-offs│
├──────────────────┼──────────────┼────────────────┼────────────────── │
│  8. Hierarchical │  Very large  │  Complex to    │  Enterprise-scale  │
│                  │  enterprise  │  build &       │  tasks, multiple   │
│                  │  tasks       │  maintain      │  departments       │
└──────────────────┴──────────────┴────────────────┴────────────────── │

  QUICK SELECTION GUIDE:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  "Small task, 1 domain"              →  Single Agent
  "Big task, needs multiple experts"  →  Supervisor
  "Many different query types"        →  Router
  "Step-by-step transformation"       →  Pipeline
  "Quality matters most"              →  Reflection
  "Independent parallel work"         →  Parallel
  "Complex decision/trade-off"        →  Debate
  "Large scale, many teams"           →  Hierarchical
```
